# RYUKSAIDSO

> RYUKSAIDSO is an agent reliability and control plane for production AI agents: durable traces, policy gates, human approvals, evaluations, version rollback and multi-provider failover in one platform.

RYUKSAIDSO lets teams plan, trace, approve, evaluate and roll back production AI agent runs with evidence instead of crossed fingers. Founded by Faizan Hameed (Faizcasm).

## Product

- [Home](https://ryuksaidso.faizcasm.me/): overview of the control plane
- [Documentation](https://ryuksaidso.faizcasm.me/docs): quickstart, environment reference, API guide, auth and production hardening
- [FAQ](https://ryuksaidso.faizcasm.me/faq): 60+ answers about traces, approvals, integrations, model providers, pricing and security
- [Pricing](https://ryuksaidso.faizcasm.me/pricing): Free, Starter, Pro and Business plans
- [Architecture](https://ryuksaidso.faizcasm.me/architecture): interactive 3D system architecture
- [Playground](https://ryuksaidso.faizcasm.me/playground): deterministic in-browser simulation of the control plane
